summary: Full e2e validation of NivXRay XDR Intelligence Controls. Offline regression: 112/112 pass (test_intelligence_policy.py + narration gateway + phase2 + telemetry + mitre). New live suite /app/backend/tests/test_intelligence_policy_live.py: 27/28 pass — global GET/PUT + defaults, hierarchy (ceiling clamp, implicit llm off, incident narrowing with source provenance), narration enforcement (deterministic + 'blocked by intelligence policy (online_llm=off)' caveat vs llm_cloud when allowed), incident audit, clear-override with action='clear', health readouts, RBAC 403 for a role-less principal and 200 for tenant_admin. Frontend: MSS dashboard + incident panel mount, all required data-testids present, ceiling dims/disables/locks the incident Online AI toggle with the 'Restricted by MSS Global policy' tooltip, incident override + clear-override + incident history all work, exec summary flips to DETERMINISTIC with the policy caveat when the ceiling is off. One real defect found: GLOBAL policy history is permanently empty in the UI because audit rows are stored with scope_id=<tenant_id> while spec/frontend query scope_id='global'.

critical.issue: Always returns history:[] — IntelligencePolicyService.set_global() writes audit rows with scope_id=tenant_id ('default'), but the spec and IntelligenceControlPanel query scope_id='global' (scopeId = 'global' for global scope). Data IS present at /api/intelligence/policy/global/default/history. Result: MSS global 'Show History' shows 'No history entries yet.' forever — governance audit trail invisible.

minor.issue: changed_by_role is recorded as 'unknown' for every UI-driven change (_role_hint reads X-Principal-Role/X-Role which the frontend never sends). Audit requirement 'changed_by_role' is technically present but never meaningful.
Pre-existing: returns 404 (3 calls) on the incident Executive tab — console errors on every load. Not part of this feature but visible during testing.

ui_bugs.issue: After turning Online AI OFF, the Online LLM toggle still renders 'ON' (data-on="true") even though the effective policy is off. Panel dims + disables + shows lock and badge 'OFFLINE ONLY' correctly, but the ON label contradicts reality because the global panel renders the RAW stored policy instead of the resolved effective policy (the AI-off PUT keeps online_llm='on' in storage).
'Show History' renders 'No history entries yet.' after multiple confirmed policy changes — caused by the scope_id mismatch backend issue above.

With global online_ai=off, incident preset buttons STANDARD / ONLINE AI ONLY stay enabled and clickable; clicking writes an override that the server clamps to off, and the UI gives no error/toast — the click appears to silently do nothing. Toggles are correctly locked, presets are not gated by canRaiseOnlineAi/canRaiseOnlineLlm.

design_issues.screen: MSS Dashboard / Incident Executive tab — Intelligence panel
issues: Panel is a very dark card on a light page; readable but the 10px uppercase sub-labels (#64748b on #0a0e1a) are borderline low-contrast for long-form scanning
Reason input has no validation/hint that it is optional; audit rows land with reason=null when left empty

action_items: FIX (HIGH): make global audit scope_id consistent — either write scope_id='global' in set_global()'s _audit call (keeping tenant_id for isolation) or have the panel query /policy/global/{tenant_id}/history. Currently global governance history is unreachable from the UI.

FIX (MEDIUM): global-scope panel should render the effective policy (or force online_llm='off' in the PUT when online_ai is turned off) so the Online LLM toggle does not display 'ON' while it is effectively OFF.
FIX (LOW): disable/annotate incident preset buttons that would widen beyond the global ceiling, or surface an inline notice that the request was clamped.
FIX (LOW): send an X-Principal-Role (or resolve the role server-side from xdr_role_assignments) so changed_by_role is not always 'unknown' in the audit trail.
INVESTIGATE (pre-existing): 404 on /api/intelligence-overlays/ from the incident Executive tab.
critical_code_review_comments: services/intelligence_policy/service.py set_global(): scope_id=tenant_id for global audit rows conflicts with the router/frontend contract scope_id='global' — single source of truth needed for the scope key.

routers/intelligence_policy.py _role_hint(): silently returns 'unknown'; for a governance/audit feature the role should be resolved from RBAC (check_access already loads assignments) rather than an untrusted client header.

GlobalPolicyBody requires both switches on every PUT, so the UI must echo the other switch — this is exactly what produces the inconsistent stored state (online_ai=off + online_llm=on). Consider a PATCH-style optional-field body normalised server-side (online_ai=off ⇒ online_llm=off).
GET /intelligence/policy/incident/{id}/effective calls _svc().get_global() and get_incident() 3x per request (effective_for_incident + two extra reads); collapse to one read pair.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (all mounts/testids/hierarchy locking work; global history empty + misleading LLM ON label)

To retest the ceiling UI, PUT global {online_ai:off,online_llm:off} then reload the incident page; always restore {on,on} afterwards.
rca_of_the_issue: IntelligencePolicyService._audit is called from set_global with scope_id=tenant_id, whereas the read path exposed to clients is /policy/{scope}/{scope_id}/history and IntelligenceControlPanel computes scopeId='global' for the global scope. The Mongo query {tenant_id, scope:'global', scope_id:'global'} therefore never matches rows stored with scope_id:'default', producing a permanently empty global audit list. Reproduce: PUT /api/intelligence/policy/global twice, then GET /api/intelligence/policy/global/global/history (empty) vs /api/intelligence/policy/global/default/history (populated).
